cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned my bowl upside down like yours. Before you leave the class, we ought to finish this stage together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's upside down to dry. The cooking's finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, the drying stage. You can check mine before you go; I wouldn't rush a finish like this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is plastic. Wipe it with a towel and pack it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the towel finish. You fold yours so neatly—show me that fold with mine, then we're done.
